name: ssh-workspace
description: Run SSH diagnostics from your computer using profiles stored in an encrypted local vault.

interface.longDescription: Keep SSH host profiles in a local encrypted vault. List aliases by group and check connectivity, platform, or Linux uptime from your computer. Connect with a key, OpenSSH user certificate, or saved password. Override the source binding and negotiation settings for individual checks.
defaultPrompt: List the SSH hosts in my Lab group.
Check SSH connectivity to my saved Debian host.

publication.release_notes: Reuse the host's OpenSSH client and optional sshpass from PATH. The source package is independent of CPU architecture.
